result:
Opened PR #427: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/427

**Summary of what shipped:**
- **Version Control**: `engineVersion`/`effectiveFrom`/`effectiveTo` added to `computationEngines`; snapshotted per-invocation so formula changes never erase history of what a past calculation used.
- **Auditability**: new `calculation_invocations` table + `invokeEngine()` wrapper, wired into the single dispatch path so every Chain-Selector-routed engine (confirmed ~160-170 today, not the stale "26" the finding cited) gets a guaranteed audit row.
- **Explainability**: optional `breakdown` steps added to income tax, GST split, gratuity, and TDS engines, rendered as a real step-by-step card in VERI Chat via a new structured-message type.
- **Formula Testing Framework**: a new data-driven golden-value test suite (16 fixtures, hand-verified statutory results) — first test coverage the engines directory has ever had.
- **AI Suggested Calculations**: a calculator-suggestion row in the composer's existing search box, since the "low value, only 12.3% wired" premise no longer holds.

I also flagged that the task's own "26 of 211 wired" figure is a stale doc snapshot (added a banner to `docs/master/CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.md`) and documented in PROGRESS.md that explainability/golden-value coverage is seeded on representative engines, not all ~211, with the mechanism left extensible for follow-on work. Full local verification (typecheck, lint, 1439 tests, build, and all repo governance checks) passed before pushing.
